name: nimib
description: nimib is a Nim library for notebook-style documents; the benchmark program renders every Markdown post through nimib's nbText into a static HTML page.
notes: nimib is a library, not a CLI: a small Nim program (src/ssgrender.nim, compiled once in the image, untimed) reads the posts and calls nbInit/nbText/nbSave per post. The timed build is the compiled binary only.
